messages:
Clara M: Two days till webinar — quick sync on engagement plan. We want a poll at 10min, live chat monitoring, and a compact QA triage flow. Who owns each?

Dev S: I can add the poll and schedule it (2 options: 'Optimize latency' vs 'Optimize cost'). Will push the trigger via StreamEngine at timestamp T+10.

Rohit P: I'll own chat moderation and the QA triage. Plan: any audience question tagged 'product' -> add to #webinar-qa, high-priority if it mentions 'enterprise' or 'SLA'.

Jen W: Lead routing tie-in: if poll response 'Optimize cost' correlates with >3 signups in 15m, tag leads with 'cost_interest' and route DM to @oncall-growth. Else batch to SDR digest every 30m.

EngageBot: [automated] poll-schedule set for 2026-06-10T17:10:00Z -> poll_id: poll_842.

Clara M: Nice. Also finalizing the fallback for the live demo: recorded clip + a short canned transition line for the host. Need a 1-line ops command to swap.

Dev S: One-liner for ops (put in runbook):
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api/stream/swap -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" -d '{"mode":"recorded","clip":"https://video.redwood/fallbacks/engage_clip.mp4"}'
```

Rohit P: QA triage: I'll tag and escalate. If a question is flagged as 'sales' + gets 2 upvotes from attendees, Webhook -> create lead in CRM and DM assigned AE.

Jen W: I'll add mapping for DM routing and confirm webhook URL tonight. Also adding a short post-webinar poll email for attendees who clicked CTA but didn't convert.

Clara M: Great. Final asks: presenters join 20min early for AV + poll dry-run at T-15. I'll publish the one-pager by 6pm. Preflight in #marketing 09:50 PT.

Dev S: Confirmed.

Rohit P: Confirmed.

Jen W: Confirmed.
